Verses.Text: The LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream at night. God said: Whatever you ask I shall give you.
Give your servant, therefore, a listening heart to judge your people and to distinguish between good and evil. For who is able to give judgment for this vast people of yours?
Is God indeed to dwell on earth? If the heavens and the highest heavens cannot contain you, how much less this temple which I have built!
After the earthquake there was fire—but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, a light silent sound.
